value.title: Hide and Go Freak
value.synopsis: Amanda disguises herself as a beast to trick Bunsen, and they play "Hide and Go Freak" together with Mikey.

value.title: Bunsen Screams for Ice Cream
value.synopsis: Amanda tries to get Bunsen expelled by using an ice cream truck to lure him out of school.

value.title: Bunsen Is a Beast!
value.synopsis: Bunsen attends his first day of human middle school in hopes of proving that beasts and humans can happily co-exist.

value.title: Body and the Beast
value.synopsis: Bunsen literally loses his head on picture day and Mikey has to help him find it before picture time.

value.title: Bearly Acceptable Behavior
value.synopsis: Amanda tries to get Bunsen kicked out of school when he brings a dangerous bear to class.

value.title: Beast Busters
value.synopsis: Bunsen and Mikey must save Amanda from mischievous sneeze beasts that escape from Bunsen's nose.

value.title: Spelling Beast
value.synopsis: Bunsen proves bees are the best spellers when he turns into one and wins the spelling bee.

value.title: Mikey Is a Beast
value.synopsis: An MMA fighter picks Bunsen to be his new mascot, so Mikey tries to prove that he is a beast too.

value.title: Fright at the Museum
value.synopsis: After discovering Bunsen's uncle in a museum, Bunsen and Mikey try to sneak him out before Amanda catches them.

value.title: Handsome Beast
value.synopsis: After Bunsen sprays himself with fancy body spray, he transforms into a hunk and becomes Amanda's desire.

value.title: Tooth or Consequences
value.synopsis: Mikey explains that Bunsen will be richer than Amanda after the tooth fairy leaves him money for all the teeth he loses during teeth losing season, so Amanda vows to catch the tooth fairy.

value.title: Beast of Friends
value.synopsis: Bunsen is excited to take Mikey to Dimmsdale to meet Cosmo on Friend-iversary, but trouble arises when Amanda secretly follows them and teams up with Mr. Crocker.

value.title: Thunder and Frightening
value.synopsis: Amanda wants to use Bunsen's fear of thunder to scare him out of Muckledunk.

value.title: Eyes on the Pies
value.synopsis: Bunsen begins to lose his memory after getting hiccups.

value.title: Happy Beastsgiving
value.synopsis: It is the beast holiday, Beastgiving, so Mikey helps Bunsen deliver dream gifts to the citizens of Muckledunk.

value.title: Beastern Standard Time
value.synopsis: Bunsen's internal clock gets thrown off during daylight saving time.

value.title: Unhappy Campers
value.synopsis: Bunsen tries to help Mikey overcome his fear of the woods during an overnight camping trip.

value.title: Hall of Justice
value.synopsis: Amanda tries to sabotage Mikey and Bunsen after they get appointed as the new hall monitors.

value.title: Astro-Nots
value.synopsis: While on a field trip to MASA, Commander Cone gives Mikey and Bunsen a tour of MASA and accidentally launches them into space.

value.title: Cookie Monster
value.synopsis: Amanda turns into a ferocious, stinky and smelly beast and causes panic at school after eating Bunsen's beast cookies.

value.title: Braces for Disaster
value.synopsis: Mikey, Bunsen and Amanda team up to study minks after Amanda's tightened braces cause her to make mink calls.

value.title: Hug It Out-ch!
value.synopsis: Amanda gets trapped in Bunsen's hugging chair and can only be released once she is happy.

value.title: Guinea Some Lovin'
value.synopsis: Bunsen falls in love with a guinea pig and tries to woo her, while Amanda tries to sabotage the love affair.

value.title: Mikey-plication
value.synopsis: To make time for their band, Bunsen clones Mikey so his clones can run all of his after school clubs.

value.title: The Case of the Cold Case
value.synopsis: Mikey and Bunsen go into detective mode after Commander Cone is framed for stealing Amanda's phone case.

value.title: Bunsen's Beast Ball
value.synopsis: Bunsen's beast ball tells him and Mikey to do fun things, until Amanda swaps out the ball for one of her own.
